# Dewiride Invoice Generator

> A free invoice generator that runs entirely in the browser. Fill in a form,
> watch the live preview, download a PDF. No account, no upload, no server:
> invoices are built client-side and never leave the device.

Operated by Dewiride Technologies Private Limited (Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India).
The tool is free with no usage limit, no paid tier and no registration step.
There is nothing to sign up for and no invoice count to exhaust.

## What it does

- Builds a professional PDF invoice from a form, with a live preview that
  matches the PDF exactly.
- Produces four documents from one editor, each correctly headed and
  captioned: tax invoice, proforma invoice, quotation and delivery challan.
  Only the invoice becomes a "TAX INVOICE" when a GSTIN is present -- a GSTIN
  on a quotation does not make it one.
- Indian GST: both GSTINs, place of supply, HSN/SAC per line, per-line
  discount deducted before tax, and the CGST + SGST or IGST split worked out
  from the supplier's state and the place of supply. GSTINs are validated
  against their own checksum digit, and tax invoice numbers are checked
  against Rule 46(b) (16 characters; letters, digits, hyphen and slash only).
- Supports 150+ currencies, formatted with the correct symbol, decimal places
  and digit grouping for each (JPY has no minor unit, KWD has three, INR
  groups as 1,23,456).
- Writes the total in words -- the Indian lakh/crore system for rupees, the
  international system with the ISO code for everything else.
- Prints a UPI payment QR built to the NPCI upi://pay link format, carrying
  the exact total and the document number as the payment note.
- Remembers businesses, clients and item descriptions in the browser for
  autocomplete, and lets the user inspect or delete all of it.
- Keeps the current draft across a page refresh, and the fifty most recent
  finished documents in IndexedDB, each document type numbered in its own
  series.
- Works on mobile, in light and dark themes, and meets WCAG AA contrast.

## What it deliberately cannot do

- It cannot produce an IRN or a signed e-invoice. Only an Invoice Registration
  Portal can. Under Rule 48(5), a business above the e-invoicing turnover
  threshold that issues an invoice any other way has issued something that
  "shall not be treated as an invoice".
- It does not file returns, connect to the GST portal, or verify a GSTIN
  against the GST network. Nothing here talks to a network at all.
- It does not claim to make anyone GST compliant. It produces a document in
  the Rule 46 format; compliance depends on registration, rates and filings.

## Privacy

No invoice content reaches a server. There is no backend that could receive
it. PDF generation happens in the browser. Anonymous, aggregate analytics
(page views, currency chosen, item count) are collected; invoice text,
names, addresses and amounts are not.

## Pages

- [Invoice generator](https://invoice.dewiride.com/): the tool itself.
- [GST invoice generator](https://invoice.dewiride.com/gst-invoice-generator/): the tool preset for an Indian tax invoice.
- [GST invoice format](https://invoice.dewiride.com/gst-invoice-format/): Rule 46 clause by clause, the 16-character serial number rule, HSN depth, time limits, e-invoicing.
- [Proforma invoice format](https://invoice.dewiride.com/proforma-invoice-format/): why it is not an invoice, and the receipt-voucher chain when an advance is paid against one.
- [Quotation format](https://invoice.dewiride.com/quotation-format/): offer versus invitation to treat under the Indian Contract Act, validity dates, and the purchase-order counter-offer trap.
- [Delivery challan format](https://invoice.dewiride.com/delivery-challan-format/): Rule 55's four cases, its nine particulars, triplicate markings, e-way bills and job work.
- [GST calculator](https://invoice.dewiride.com/tools/gst-calculator/): add or remove GST using Rule 35's formula, with the current rate schedule.
- [UPI QR generator](https://invoice.dewiride.com/tools/upi-qr-generator/): the upi://pay grammar, static versus dynamic, and the limits.
- [Amount in words](https://invoice.dewiride.com/tools/amount-in-words/): the Indian numbering system, and where the words legally beat the figures.
- [About](https://invoice.dewiride.com/about/): who operates it, and contact details.
- [Privacy policy](https://invoice.dewiride.com/privacy/): what is and is not collected.
- [Terms of service](https://invoice.dewiride.com/terms/): terms of use.

## For automated agents

The page is built to be driven without CSS selectors. Every control has a
unique accessible name within its landmark, and the form's completion state is
exposed both as visible text and as a `data-invoice-complete` attribute on an
element with `role="status"`, so an agent can tell "ready" from "half-filled"
without re-deriving the rule. Filling the labelled fields and activating the
"Download as PDF" button is the whole flow.
